dial_style: Brown sunray dial, date at 3 o'clock
best_for: Steel analog watch, listed for formal, casual and party occasions
verdict: A steel analog watch with a brown sunray dial and a date window, listed with 50 m water resistance.
paragraphs: The store listing describes a metal watch with hour, minute and seconds hands. The dial has a sunray finish in brown, and the date sits at 3 o'clock.

The listing gives a 39 mm stainless steel case, a mineral glass cover and 50 m water resistance. It also lists an ion-plated finish, an SR626SW silver oxide battery, and the occasions formal, casual and party.
The listing gives the strap colour as silver and the band as stainless steel.
good: Sunray dial finish, as the listing describes
Stainless steel case and band, per the listing
50 m water-resistance rating, per the listing
SR626SW silver oxide battery, per the listing
not_good: In our view, a brown dial will not suit everyone
The listing does not state the movement type
